 Add as a preferred source on Google Kerala Lottery Result Today: The Kerala State Lottery Department has announced the Karunya Plus KN-648 lottery result today, Thursday, November 5th Lottery ticket holders eagerly awaiting the draw can check their winning numbers after the live draw begins at 2:55 PM, with the official results expected to be published around 4:30 PM.
 The Karunya Plus KN-648 lottery offers a bumper first prize of Rs. 1 crore, along with several other prize categories for ticket holders.
 The draw is scheduled to take place at Gorky Bhavan, near Bakery Junction, Palayam, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala.

 Kerala Lottery Prize Claim: How to Collect Your Winnings
 Kerala lottery winners must follow the prize-claim procedures prescribed by the Kerala State Lotteries Department.
According to the supplied prize-claim information:
 Prizes below Rs. 5,000: Winners may claim their prizes through authorised lottery agents or shops, subject to the applicable rules.
 Prizes above Rs. 5,000: Winners are required to submit their tickets through the prescribed bank or government lottery office process, along with valid identification documents.
 Lottery winners should keep their original tickets safe and ensure that the ticket is signed and properly verified before submitting it for a claim.
 For larger prizes, winners should check the latest official claim guidelines, documentation requirements and submission deadlines.
 Kerala Lottery Tax Deduction and Agent Commission
 Lottery winners should also consider applicable deductions while calculating their final prize amount.
 The supplied information mentions a 30% tax deduction and a 12% agent commission. However, the actual deductions depend on the applicable tax provisions and official lottery rules.
 Winners should verify the applicable tax and commission details with the Kerala State Lotteries Department before claiming their prizes.
